study.question: Can an explicit interaction between current static fields and the centered, count-shrunk feedback residual improve validation macro AUC beyond both its additive capacity control and the incumbent, and is that effect specific to count mixing? Observed code limitation: the incumbent adds a history-only MLP correction to core logits. Holding embedded history, historical masks and category/brand match groups fixed, its residual cannot depend on other current target/user/context fields, although the core already can. The incumbent g2-r0011-center_count scores 0.8280959704981011, only +0.00003481149721484833 over g2-r0011-absolute_count and +0.00019291076389293949 over center_fixed. Its macro Logloss 0.054807281191186864 is worse than absolute_count 0.054800759323038614. Relative to the stronger source g0-r0003-relation_content_counts (0.8275704845768582), incumbent macro improves +0.0005254859212429075, but favorite AUC changes -0.0000325233057106. Relative to count_shrink (0.8272805336635536), macro improves +0.0008154368345475449 while buy AUC falls -0.0020075991130585. These are measured single-seed trade-offs, not repeated mechanism support. Verified public source SHA256s for the baseline, both sources and incumbent match receipts. Raw parquet verification, training and numerical prerequisites cannot be independently rerun in this proposal-only environment; inherited successful validation receipts supply the starting point, not new data verification.
study.hypothesis: Current user/context/target fields change how visible history feedback should affect a prediction. The present purely additive residual leaves that conditioning to the core, which does not directly receive these structured four-mask statistics. Late interaction h+c+h*c, with history hidden h and bounded current-context hidden c, may expose complementary history/field conjunctions while keeping the successful relation-content core. Count shrinkage may make that interaction more useful by damping noisy moments. This is an untested representational and optimization hypothesis. Neither centered moments nor count interpolation have independent-seed confirmation here.

study.proposed_difference: For static embedding tensor x (current authorized user/context fields plus six target item fields; excludes current action), let r be the unchanged 296D residual features, h=SiLU(W_h r+b_h) in R^64 and c=tanh(W_c flatten(x)+b_c) in R^64. Read out W_o[h+c+k*(h*c)]+b_o, where k=1 for cross and k=0 for additive. Both arms retain both main effects and calculate the same product; only its fixed multiplier differs. The multiplicative gain 1+c is bounded between 0 and 2. Both arms append identical W_c,b_c, initialized to zero after inherited reset and within CPU RNG isolation. With c=0 their residual equals the parent even for a nonzero shared output layer; initial total logits equal the source. Empty histories still force the complete residual, including biases, to zero. Cross this replacement with count n/(n+4) versus fixed 0.5 mixing. No new sample information, learnable task-loss weights, sequence length, labels, data passes or training recipe changes. New trainable parameters in every arm are 64*(16*S+1), where S is the existing static_count, on top of parent total 32964809 / dense 1171593 / embedding 31793216. Host must measure exact counts. This ordinary hidden interaction is a local experimental difference, not a verified novel architecture.
predictions: Primary paired contrasts: cross_count - add_count and cross_fixed - add_fixed in full-validation macro AUC. A positive cross_count effect accompanied by improvement over g2-r0011-center_count and both source bests would motivate repetition; improvement only over the older sources is insufficient to advance beyond the incumbent.

Count-specific complementarity requires positive interaction I=(AUC_cross_count-AUC_add_count)-(AUC_cross_fixed-AUC_add_fixed). A context gain in both mixing modes with I near zero supports general context conditioning provisionally, not special count/context synergy. Report both simple effects and I without significance claims from one seed.

Report all task AUC/Logloss changes versus DIN, both frozen sources, incumbent and each paired control, plus macro Logloss, total/dense/embedding parameters, training time, inference p50/p95, throughput and peak memory. In particular disclose purchase regression versus count_shrink and favorite regression versus the relation source even when macro AUC rises; no undeclared per-task veto.

Exploratory slices use the already fixed history bins empty, 1-16, 17-64 and >64; report counts and each task positives/negatives. Existing bin samples are 6444, 461684, 1001754, 1401885. Empty-history positives are only 427/45/28/13, so its auxiliary estimates are imprecise. Do not infer residual efficacy from empty-history changes: its residual is masked, while shared core training can still change.

Host prerequisite gates BEFORE full jobs: real torch construction, four [B,1] finite probabilities, finite backward in FP32/BF16, output and gradient checks after a nonzero readout step (initial context gradient may be zero because output weights start zero); verify identical new-arm parameter counts/initial states and unchanged inherited source state/CPU RNG. Check zero-context source equivalence with shared nonzero residual readout and verify product-on/off behavior using synthetic isolated hidden inputs.

Host boundary gates: eval and cloned-state train invariance to masked historical IDs/actions/task-mask values and any current action perturbation, finite all-empty/mixed/full/holey histories including length 0 and 100, empty residual exactly zero after learned biases, and sensitivity to valid history/static fields. Exclude labels and metadata from forward. Host training/scoring and all gates consume the declared campaign budget; if unavailable, report numerical execution unverified rather than asserting passage.
falsifiers: If cross_count does not exceed its additive matched-capacity control, this implementation supplies no evidence for useful explicit context/history interaction, even if both beat the smaller parent. Extra static capacity or main effects would remain the simpler explanation.

If cross improves neither mixing mode or fails to exceed the incumbent at measured justified cost, retain the incumbent. One failed implementation limits this late bounded cross under the frozen recipe; it does not refute context conditioning generally.
If I is nonpositive or changes sign across paired repetitions, the claimed special complementarity with count shrinkage is unsupported. A positive one-seed I alone is only an observation.

Failure of shared-state null equivalence, data-order/RNG consistency, masking/current-action invariance, finite gradients or parameter equality invalidates an attribution contrast. Retain the failed gate receipt and cost; do not alter the frozen data/scorer/training contracts to repair it.

If the gain disappears in paired independent-seed validation repetitions, or has an unfavorable measured cost frontier, classify it as preliminary/unjustified. Do not access a withheld split, bootstrap impressions as independent users, or use closed assessment feedback to repair the mechanism.
alternative_explanations: Equal parameter count does not equal identical functional capacity or gradient conditioning; the explicit product changes both the interaction class and optimization under the frozen single pass.
Embeddings are shared between core, current fields and history. Core parameters start identically but can diverge during training; this is an end-to-end effect, not a frozen-backbone probe.

Same fixed seed is a paired contrast, not independent replication. Numerous earlier validation-guided choices create selection uncertainty; deterministic archived duplicates do not add independent support.
The current static branch includes all authorized user/context/target item embeddings. A gain would not identify which field group matters without subsequent component attribution.

Current fields may merely recalibrate nonempty-history subpopulations. The additive context control includes the same static information and parameter count to distinguish that explanation from an explicit product.

Added static branch gradients can benefit the inherited core rather than the residual interaction itself. A later stop-gradient/frozen-backbone or context-field replacement contrast would be needed for a stronger localization claim; none is silently included now.

User-background centering uses the same events and includes the tested slot; it is neither an independent prior nor a causal counterfactual. Auxiliary labels match user/category/brand within 24 hours, not advertisement-specific conversion. The official_offline history and publisher vocabularies/static snapshots do not establish production point-in-time validity.

We have no authorized sample-level predictions or cluster IDs in this coding phase. Paired user-cluster bootstrap is conditional on future host provision; otherwise seed ranges and full slice counts are reported, with no invented confidence intervals.
